concerns.text: Task T040 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it performs a PR to amend the Constitution, a side‑effect that must be serialized. Marking it parallel‑safe is unsafe.
Task T029 is a test that depends on the output of T028 (`results_report.csv`). Because it has a producer‑consumer relationship, it cannot be safely marked `[P]`.
Task T033 orchestrates the entire pipeline and depends on many prior artifacts. Declaring it `[P]` creates a false parallel‑safe claim; the orchestration must run after its dependencies.

User Story 2 (Phase 4) requires the merged dataset produced by User Story 1 (Phase 3). This creates a cross‑story data dependency, violating the rule that each user‑story block must be independently implementable and testable.
